top_signals.title: The Atlantic Brief: The Strait of Hormuz and the Future of Free Navigation
top_signals.summary:
In February 2026, the United States and Israel initiated a war in the Middle East against Iran. Since then, the warring sides have oscillated between strikes, a fragile ceasefire, and the blocking of the Strait of Hormuz. Open hostilities resumed in mid-July.
